Resonance source code: GPL-3.0-or-later, copyright 2026 Resonance contributors.
Third-party components retain their own licenses. They run separately or, for
Sparkle, are linked as a framework.

yt-dlp 2026.10.26: Unlicense with bundled third-party dependencies.
Source: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/tree/2026.10.26
See yt-dlp-Unlicense.txt and yt-dlp-third-party.txt for the standalone distribution.

FFmpeg 9.0.2: LGPL-2.1-or-later in the included configuration (no GPL-only codecs).
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
LAME 3.100: LGPL-2.0-or-later. Source: https://lame.sourceforge.io/
Opus 1.5.2: BSD-style. Source: https://opus-codec.org/
See the respective license files and ffmpeg-ARCH-build.txt for exact configuration.
Pinned source archives and build recipes are attached to each release in the
corresponding-source archive. These inputs reproduce the distributed media tools.

QuickJS-ng 0.17.0: MIT.
Source: https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/tree/v0.17.0
See QuickJS-MIT.txt. Compiled with a macOS 13 deployment target for each CPU.

Sparkle 2.10.1: BSD-style and included third-party notices.
Source: https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/tree/2.10.1
See Sparkle.txt in the packaged app and vendor/sparkle/LICENSE in a development tree.

The complete dependency download URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in vendor/manifest.json.
